meta.title: Only "TR Submitted" line items are eligible for re-evaluation

steps.note: Open an existing event with a closed technical stage and a vendor response ready for evaluation.
Navigate to the technical stage where the re-evaluation action is available.

args.goal: Open the Request Re-Evaluation drawer, inspect Select Line Items, try to select a line item that is not marked TR Submitted, and verify that the non-TR Submitted item cannot be selected while TR Submitted items remain eligible; leave the drawer open.

steps.note: Perform and verify the drawer-specific eligibility behavior that no dedicated catalog step exposes.
Confirm the re-evaluation selection drawer remains visible after checking the eligibility rule.
